newsitem.title: USA: First Brands to redeem $100 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: First Brands to redeem $100 mln notes.

text.p: First Brands Corp Friday said that, subject to the successful completion of a private placement of a $150 million new series of senior notes, it intends to call for redemption its $100 million 9-1/8 percent Senior Subordinated Notes due 1999.

The redemption at par, will be funded with the proceeds of such senior note placement and is expected to occur in early April 1997. Excess proceeds from the placement will be used to reduce borrowings under the company's bank credit facilities.
The new series of senior notes will not be registered under the Securities Act and may not be sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from registration requirements.
